question: How do joint-LM (q0, omega) basin radii scale across an |omega|-stratified cohort, and what is the binding cohort tolerance for the omega prior?
hypothesis: The s040 (n=3) finding that low-|omega| tumblers have wide omega-mag basins and high-|omega| tumblers have narrow ones generalises to the cohort; truth/twin basins are reflection-symmetric.
narrative_md: 13-seed |omega|-stratified joint-LM basin probe (780 LMs, 36 min). The omega-mag basin inversely correlates with |omega| (rough rule ~1-2% / |omega|_dps^0.5..1); the binding case is seed 14 at +0.5%/-2% omega-mag and 0.5 deg omega-dir. Truth/twin basins are reflection-symmetric on 12/13 seeds (seed 89 the lone asymmetry). Surfaced a new uncatalogued seed-14 multi-solution attractor at rho 2.78 / q0_err 86 deg. Perturbs from truth and twin states, so it reads truth as input.
